# EHL Hospitality Insights

> > Research, analysis, and thought leadership from EHL Hospitality Business School on global hospitality trends, luxury management, and industry transformation.

EHL Hospitality Insights is the knowledge hub of EHL Hospitality Business School in Lausanne, Switzerland, featuring industry reports, executive interviews, webinars, and academic research covering hospitality education, digital transformation, post-COVID recovery, and luxury sector management across Europe and Asia-Pacific markets.

## Key Topics

- EHL Hospitality Business School
- Hospitality Education
- Post-COVID Recovery & Resilience
- Digital Transformation
- Luxury Management
- Swiss Watchmaking Industry
- Hospitality Leadership
- Asia-Pacific Hospitality
- Industry Research & Reports
- Pandemic Impact Analysis
- Singapore Hospitality Market
- Webinar Series
- CEO Interviews & Podcasts
- Business Management Insights

## Industry Reports & Research

- [Industry Reports](https://hospitalityinsights.ehl.edu/resources/all-tags/industry-reports): Collection of hospitality industry reports and research publications
- [Research](https://hospitalityinsights.ehl.edu/resources/all-tags/research): Academic research resources from EHL Hospitality Business School

## Future of Hospitality

- [Resilience: The future of the Hospitality Industry](https://hospitalityinsights.ehl.edu/resources/all-resources/future-3): Webinar on COVID-19 impact ft. Joshua Gan, Joel Oei on hospitality future

## Leadership Interviews & Podcasts

- [Conversation with Alain Delamuraz, CEO of Montres Jaquet Droz SA](https://hospitalityinsights.ehl.edu/resources/all-resources/luxury-watch-industry): Podcast with Alain Delamuraz on Swiss watchmaking & luxury management
